description: This Java source file defines a final class `TenantMapper` that implements Spring's `RowMapper` interface for mapping SQL query results to `FineractPlatformTenant` objects. It constructs SQL queries to retrieve tenant and connection data, maps result set rows to domain objects, and handles schema-specific logic based on whether it is generating a report or OLTP data.

classes.name: TenantMapper
classes.description: A final class that maps SQL result set rows to `FineractPlatformTenant` objects, building complex SQL queries based on report or OLTP context.

methods.name: TenantMapper
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the mapper with a report mode flag.

methods.name: schema
methods.description: Constructs the SQL query string based on whether the data is for a report or OLTP, appending appropriate join conditions.

methods.name: mapRow
methods.description: Maps a row from the ResultSet to a `FineractPlatformTenant` object, including nested connection information.

methods.name: getDBConnection
methods.description: Helper method to extract database connection details from the ResultSet and instantiate a `FineractPlatformTenantConnection` object.
